GlobalFoundries plans Atlas trials in 2027 and expands Spot deployment

The expanded collaboration makes the chipmaker Atlas’s first non-automotive trial customer, while Spot already has reported factory-inspection results.

Boston Dynamics ↗17 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2Videos 1

Two robot platforms, different stages

Boston Dynamics and GlobalFoundries announced on November 17 that Spot deployments will expand across Malta, New York; Burlington, Vermont; Dresden; and Singapore. Onsite Atlas testing is planned for early 2027. The announcement identifies GlobalFoundries as the first Atlas trial customer outside the automotive industry.

Spot results are not Atlas results

The companies report that two Spot robots in Singapore have completed more than 90,000 inspections since April, traveled nearly 900 kilometers and achieved a 99% mission success rate. These are reported Spot results in sub-fab areas, not Atlas results or a guarantee for every task and facility.

Atlas begins with use-case evaluation

The Atlas skills workshop will evaluate potential tasks, site readiness and integration requirements before early training and task testing. The release does not identify the number of Atlas robots or selected jobs. Its linked 2022 case-study video documents earlier Spot work and should not be mistaken for footage of the forthcoming Atlas trial.
